description: This file defines a class hierarchy for handling iCalendar properties, including property validation, serialization, and specific implementations for different iCalendar attributes used in calendar components.

classes.name: iCalendar_property
classes.description: Base class representing a generic iCalendar property with methods for validation, setting values, parameters, and serialization.

classes.name: iCalendar_property_calscale
classes.description: Represents the CALSCALE property, typically 'GREGORIAN'.

classes.name: iCalendar_property_method
classes.description: Represents the METHOD property, with validation for specific method values.

classes.name: iCalendar_property_prodid
classes.description: Represents the PRODID property indicating product identifier.

classes.name: iCalendar_property_version
classes.description: Represents the VERSION property, defaulting to '2.0'.

classes.name: iCalendar_property_attach
classes.description: Represents the ATTACH property, usually a URI with parameters like FMTTYPE and ENCODING.

classes.name: iCalendar_property_categories
classes.description: Represents the CATEGORIES property with multiple text values.

classes.name: iCalendar_property_class
classes.description: Represents the CLASS property with allowed values 'PUBLIC', 'PRIVATE', 'CONFIDENTIAL', or an x-name.

classes.name: iCalendar_property_comment
classes.description: Represents the COMMENT property.

classes.name: iCalendar_property_description
classes.description: Represents the DESCRIPTION property.

classes.name: iCalendar_property_geo
classes.description: Represents the GEO property, requiring two float values separated by a semicolon.

classes.name: iCalendar_property_location
classes.description: Represents the LOCATION property.

classes.name: iCalendar_property_percent_complete
classes.description: Represents the PERCENT-COMPLETE property, an integer between 0 and 100.

classes.name: iCalendar_property_priority
classes.description: Represents the PRIORITY property, an integer between 0 and 9, validation commented out.

classes.name: iCalendar_property_resources
classes.description: Represents the RESOURCES property with multiple text values.

classes.name: iCalendar_property_status
classes.description: Represents the STATUS property, with validation commented out.

classes.name: iCalendar_property_summary
classes.description: Represents the SUMMARY property.

classes.name: iCalendar_property_completed
classes.description: Represents the COMPLETED property, date-time in UTC.

classes.name: iCalendar_property_dtend
classes.description: Represents the DTEND property with validation for UTC time if in VFREEBUSY.

classes.name: iCalendar_property_due
classes.description: Represents the DUE property, similar validation as DTEND.

classes.name: iCalendar_property_dtstart
classes.description: Represents the DTSTART property with validation.

classes.name: iCalendar_property_duration
classes.description: Represents the DURATION property, value must be positive.

classes.name: iCalendar_property_freebusy
classes.description: Represents the FREEBUSY property with multiple periods.

classes.name: iCalendar_property_transp
classes.description: Represents the TRANSP property, values 'TRANSPARENT' or 'OPAQUE'.

classes.name: iCalendar_property_attendee
classes.description: Represents the ATTENDEE property with multiple parameters.

classes.name: iCalendar_property_contact
classes.description: Represents the CONTACT property.

classes.name: iCalendar_property_organizer
classes.description: Represents the ORGANIZER property.

classes.name: iCalendar_property_recurrence_id
classes.description: Represents the RECURRENCE-ID property with parameter validation.

classes.name: iCalendar_property_related_to
classes.description: Represents the RELATED-TO property.

classes.name: iCalendar_property_url
classes.description: Represents the URL property.

classes.name: iCalendar_property_uid
classes.description: Represents the UID property, auto-generates a GUID as default.

classes.name: iCalendar_property_exdate
classes.description: Represents the EXDATE property, multiple date-time values.

classes.name: iCalendar_property_exrule
classes.description: Represents the EXRULE property.

classes.name: iCalendar_property_rdate
classes.description: Represents the RDATE property, multiple date-time values.

classes.name: iCalendar_property_rrule
classes.description: Represents the RRULE property.

classes.name: iCalendar_property_created
classes.description: Represents the CREATED property, in UTC.

classes.name: iCalendar_property_dtstamp
classes.description: Represents the DTSTAMP property, in UTC.

classes.name: iCalendar_property_last_modified
classes.description: Represents the LAST-MODIFIED property in UTC.

classes.name: iCalendar_property_sequence
classes.description: Represents the SEQUENCE property, non-negative integer.

classes.name: iCalendar_property_x
classes.description: Represents an arbitrary X- property with validation.

classes.name: iCalendar_property_request_status
classes.description: Represents the REQUEST-STATUS property with complex validation of the text format.

classes.name: iCalendar_property_trigger
classes.description: Represents the TRIGGER property.

classes.name: iCalendar_property_action
classes.description: Represents the ACTION property.

classes.name: iCalendar_property_x_wr_alarmuid
classes.description: Represents a custom property for alarm UID.

classes.name: iCalendar_property_tzoffsetto
classes.description: Represents the TZOFFSETTO property.

classes.name: iCalendar_property_daylightc
classes.description: Represents DAYLIGHTC, integer value.

classes.name: iCalendar_property_standardc
classes.description: Represents STANDARDC, integer value.

classes.name: iCalendar_property_tzid
classes.description: Represents the TZID property.
